node.chars: Data: synthetic only (spec L68: a seeded synthetic BTCUSDT profile declared on each board): BTCUSDT 30-minute bars seeded 416, 10 Oct – 31 Oct 2026 14:30 UTC; tick size 0.10 from the recorded instrument fixture. kids.chars: Fidelity: greyscale wireframe, desktop, 1280 × 800 windows (§0 L68); wire tokens only (§2 L126): color.surface.canvas, color.surface.raised, color.surface.overlay, color.border.default, color.text.primary, color.text.secondary, color.text.tertiary; type.ui.caption, type.ui.label, type.num.sm. kids.name: value-5
kids.chars: Not drawn — the text is binding (§0 L83): SCR-038/load-failed, SCR-038/stale, SCR-039/comfortable, SCR-038/tpo-detail

value-4.chars: Analytics (§10.4, payloads PROPOSED): host ∈ {docked, overlay}; no symbol, account, user or order id; profile.settings_changed ({key}, one per changed key) is emitted at SCR-039 Save (board 08); the profile.* namespace clash is D02-C7

value-5.chars: ≥ 55 fps (§10.3): in Visible range a pan or zoom re-renders only the plot and the legend; recompute <= 10 Hz with a debounce on pan end; the table patches at most once per second
